title: How to Add a Size Chart in Shopify with Metafields (Different Chart for Each Product)
description:
A step-by-step walkthrough on a Shopify dev store with the Impression theme. No apps: just Shopify metafields, a page with your size chart, and the theme's built-in size guide.

0:00 Step 1: Create the size guide metafield
0:50 Step 2: Create a page with your size chart
1:22 Step 3: Connect the page to your products
2:15 Turn on the size guide in the theme editor
2:40 Additional fields: model photo and model info
4:16 Bulk edit: assign one chart to many products
